project.title: Circuit Builder
project.summary: Circuit game with lessons and a simulator.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: An interactive circuit simulator with built-in lessons. Users place components, wire them together, and observe current flow and voltage in real time.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body: JavaScript-based circuit simulator using a node-matrix solver for DC analysis. The UI renders components and wires on an HTML5 Canvas.

sections.title: Planning
sections.body: Lessons were designed to progress from basic (battery + resistor) to complex (capacitors, oscillators).

sections.title: Demo
sections.body: Try the simulator and view the repository.
